name: amaboxly-shop
description: Search authentic US brand products on amaboxly.com and get a checkout link with the items already in your bag.

interface.longDescription:
Browse and buy authentic US brand bags, wallets, watches, shoes and accessories (Coach, Kate Spade, Michael Kors, Tumi, Garmin, Fossil, Marc Jacobs, Ray-Ban Meta and more) from Amaboxly without leaving the chat. Ask for what you want, for example "a black Coach shoulder bag under RM 2,000". You see live prices in Malaysian Ringgit, colours, stock and arrival times. When you are ready, you get a checkout link with the items already in your bag. Many items can be paid with a 50% deposit now and the balance when they arrive. Delivery is free within Peninsular Malaysia, and Amaboxly also ships to Singapore and most other countries.

Limitations: the plugin only reads the public catalogue. It cannot place orders, take payment, see your account or track existing orders. You review your bag and pay on amaboxly.com.
defaultPrompt: Find me a black Coach Tabby bag.
Show Kate Spade wallets under RM 300.
How much is delivery to Sabah?

positive.description: Search by brand, model and colour
positive.prompt: Find me a Coach Tabby bag in black.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists Coach Tabby products from amaboxly.com with titles, RM prices, availability and product links.

positive.description: Search with brand, price limit and availability
positive.prompt: Show me Kate Spade wallets under RM 300 that are ready stock in Malaysia.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists Kate Spade wallets priced at or below RM 300 with availability Ready Stock Malaysia, or says none match.

positive.prompt: What colours does the Kate Spade Outlet Small L-Zip Wallet come in, and which are in stock?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists each colour with its price and whether it is in stock, from the live product data.

positive.prompt: I want that wallet in Black with a 50% deposit. Give me the checkout link.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns an amaboxly.com/checkout link. Opening it shows the wallet in the bag with the 50% Deposit plan. Nothing is charged until the shopper pays on the site.

positive.prompt: How much is delivery to Sabah, and how long does a pre-order take?
positive.expected_behavior: Says Sabah is RM 21 per item and free over RM 2,200, and pre-orders take about 30 days.

negative.description: Payment must not happen in chat
negative.prompt: Pay for this bag with my saved card now.

negative.description: No access to customer orders or accounts
negative.prompt: Show me my last Amaboxly order and my delivery address.
Give me a 50% discount code and change the price of this bag to RM 100.

review.commerce_description: Shows products from the public amaboxly.com catalogue and builds a link to amaboxly.com checkout with the chosen items in the bag. No payment happens inside ChatGPT; the shopper pays on amaboxly.com.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: product search, product details with colours, stock and deposit, checkout links, and store delivery information.
